contract.explicit_requirement: len(data) <= 100 (constraint_id: milvus_range_entities_insert_001, assertion quoted verbatim from contract)

physical.objective_constraint: Milvus gRPC InsertRequest.NumRows is uint32 (max 4,294,967,295), no mathematical lower bound >0 for insert count per request. REST layer claiming 100 limit is arbitrary, not a physical constraint.

behavioral.note: API优雅处理(返回200+完整结果),但源码无显式by-design注释或常量表示此为有意设计。
